transmission.notes: Aphids acquire the virus rapidly during feeding and can transmit it within minutes.

symptoms: Necrotic streaks or etched patterns on leaves
Occasional fruit discoloration or necrotic lesions
disease_cycle: Virus survives in infected host plants and weeds
Aphids acquire virus during feeding on infected plants
Virus is transmitted to healthy plants during probing
Mechanical transmission can occur via contaminated tools or handling

special_protein.name: TEV protease
special_protein.function: Highly specific protease used widely in biotechnology to cleave fusion proteins during purification.

cultural: Remove weed hosts that serve as virus reservoirs
vector_control: Use reflective mulches to repel aphids
Apply insecticides if aphid pressure is high
resistance: Use resistant or tolerant cultivars when available

impact.economic: Can cause significant yield losses in pepper and tobacco crops
impact.agronomic: Severe infections reduce fruit quality and plant vigor
